SELECT imf.INT_MAN_FEE_CD, imf.INTG_FEE_ID AS chargeMonth, imf.INTG_FEE_AMOUNT AS amount,
cb.CHGBILL_AMOUNT, cb.CHGBILL_STATUS, statusCode.CODE_NAME AS chgbillStatusName, cb.CHGBILL_DUE_DATE,
residentMember.MBR_NM AS residentName, rentalPartyMember.MBR_NM AS rentalPartyName, b.BLDG_NM AS buildingName,
cd.CODE_NAME AS intManFeeName, cd.DESCRIPTION AS intManFeeDesc
FROM INTEGRATED_MANAGEMENT_FEE imf
INNER JOIN CHARGE_BILL cb ON cb.UNIT_ID = imf.UNIT_ID AND cb.BLDG_ID = imf.BLDG_ID AND cb.RENTAL_PTY_ID = imf.RENTAL_PTY_ID AND cb.CHGBILL_CHARGE_MONTH = imf.INTG_FEE_ID
LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE statusCode ON statusCode.CODE_GROUP = 'IFSTA' AND statusCode.CODE_VALUE = cb.CHGBILL_STATUS
LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE cd ON cd.CODE_GROUP = 'INTMF' AND cd.CODE_VALUE = imf.INT_MAN_FEE_CD
LEFT JOIN UNIT_RESIDENT ur ON ur.UNIT_ID = imf.UNIT_ID
LEFT JOIN MEMBER residentMember ON residentMember.MBR_CD = ur.MBR_CD
LEFT JOIN TENANCY t ON t.RENTAL_PTY_ID = imf.RENTAL_PTY_ID
LEFT JOIN MEMBER rentalPartyMember ON rentalPartyMember.MBR_CD = t.MBR_CD
LEFT JOIN BUILDING b ON b.BLDG_ID = imf.BLDG_ID
WHERE imf.UNIT_ID = #{unitId} AND imf.INTG_FEE_ID IN
#{month}
ORDER BY imf.INT_MAN_FEE_CD, imf.INTG_FEE_ID

SELECT imf.INT_MAN_FEE_CD AS feeCode, cd.CODE_NAME AS feeName, cd.DESCRIPTION AS description, imf.INTG_FEE_AMOUNT AS amount FROM INTEGRATED_MANAGEMENT_FEE imf LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE cd ON cd.CODE_GROUP = 'INTMF' AND cd.CODE_VALUE = imf.INT_MAN_FEE_CD WHERE imf.UNIT_ID = #{unitId} AND imf.INTG_FEE_ID = #{month} ORDER BY imf.INT_MAN_FEE_CD
